coverage.label: NEET PG official data
coverage.summary: MCC 2026 Round 1 published matrices contain 31,708 seats. The historical explorer contains 42,921 cutoff observations derived from MCC 2025 final allotment results. 5,616 current seat pools have an exact historical match.
limitations: MCC counselling only. State counselling outside these MCC sources is not included in the seat and cutoff dataset.
The 2026 matrices are a dated publication snapshot and can be revised; they are not a live vacancy feed.
Historical cutoffs aggregate current-round allotments by allotted seat category. Held seats without a new allocation are excluded from later-round observations.

Cross-year institution matching uses exact full addresses or unique exact names within the same explicit state. Generic names, ambiguous identities and conflicting postcodes are excluded from name matching. Course code, quota and allotted category must also match. Unmatched rows are not labelled new seats.
Financial source coverage is limited and separately dated. Missing fees, stipends or bond terms remain unknown.
No fictional colleges, demo ranks or other exams are included. Personal candidate identifiers are excluded.

guides.title: Check eligibility for each seat pool
guides.body: MCC’s 2026 bulletin requires NEET-PG qualification and the applicable MBBS, registration and internship credentials. The internship completion cut-off listed is 30 September 2026. Institutional, minority, NRI and state seats can have additional conditions. Qualification alone does not establish eligibility for every seat.

guides.title: Prepare originals and clear scans
guides.body: The MCC checklist includes allotment letter, NBEMS admit card and result, MBBS marksheets and degree, internship certificate, medical registration, birth-date proof and accepted ID. Add applicable category, PwBD, NRI or OCI documents. Check the allotted institution’s additional requirements.

guides.title: Understand Freeze and Float in 2026
guides.body: Freeze accepts the seat without further upgrade and requires physical joining. Float seeks an upgrade and uses online willingness and document verification for the relevant earlier-round transition. Follow the 2026 workflow and allotted institute’s instructions; do not assume an earlier year’s process applies.

guides.title: Read the rule for your current round
guides.body: Joining, upgradation, resignation, security-deposit forfeiture and later-round eligibility depend on the round and your status. Read the corresponding 2026 bulletin section before acting. A saved Zyjock choice list does not change your MCC candidature.

guides.title: Register on the official portal
guides.body: Use the registration link from MCC’s PG page. The candidate guide covers identity details, qualification, internship, contact verification and payment. Match your official examination documents, retain the submitted application and payment acknowledgement, and use the portal’s own status to confirm completion.

guides.title: Submit and lock the official choice list
guides.body: Use Zyjock to compare and order options, then enter the choices in the official counselling portal. MCC’s candidate guide explains adding, arranging, saving and locking choices. Confirm the final saved list and current locking deadline on MCC; exporting a planner does not submit choices.

guides.title: Check document verification status
guides.body: After the required willingness step, use the official portal to upload the requested documents and inspect any institute discrepancy. The 2026 candidate guide includes the discrepancy-response workflow. Keep readable copies and act within the deadline shown by the authority.

guides.title: Use your official NEET-PG rank
guides.body: NBEMS’s 24 September 2026 notice reports scores out of 720. Initial qualifying scores are 262 for General/EWS, 244 for General PwBD and 226 for SC/ST/OBC including PwBD. These are qualification thresholds, not college admission cut-offs. Use the rank on your official result for historical allotment comparisons.

guides.title: Check each state’s own application dates
guides.body: The MCC coordination sheet gives state round windows alongside AIQ rounds. It does not replace a state prospectus, registration notice or deadline. Open the relevant state authority below and select PG Medical for the 2026 session before using a schedule or eligibility rule.

guides.title: Check the latest NRI document update
guides.body: MCC’s 14 October corrigendum adds valid passport evidence for the specified parent, sibling or sponsor in the affected NRI categories. Read it together with the 2026 bulletin before registration and verification.

guides.title: Use the official PwBD assessment route
guides.body: MCC’s 15 October clarification identifies NMC as the authority for disability eligibility and course-suitability rules. Consult the current NMC guidelines and MCC notices for the required assessment route. A general disability certificate alone should not be assumed to complete counselling requirements.

guides.title: Compare the complete cost
guides.body: Read tuition, other annual charges, deposits, university fees, hostel and mess separately. Check the published stipend and any service or course-discontinuation condition. The NMC disclosure notice is linked here; the verified examples in Zyjock retain their source year and do not replace an institution’s current fee notice.

guides.title: DNB tuition versus the annual course fee
guides.body: NBEMS’s January–May 2026 accreditation bulletin lists ₹75,000 annual tuition, ₹15,000 library, ₹15,000 appraisal and ₹20,000 accommodation: ₹1,25,000 across these heads. The total is not tuition alone. Check the accommodation conditions, payment instructions and later NBEMS notices. This reference does not set MD/MS college fees.
